title: CrossCodex Ingestion structured output
description: The document stored at structured_json_uri. Four rules are outside JSON Schema and are checked by the service in code: element_id values are unique, non-null id values are unique, a non-null parent_id names an earlier element, and metadata.element_count equals the number of elements.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR version the output conforms to. This file validates every released 1.x: minors only add optional fields.

elementId.$comment: (?![\s\S]) anchors the end of the string; '$' would also accept a trailing newline in Python.
elementId.description: Opaque identifier, unique within the document: e- followed by 3 to 30 digits.

nonBlankString.description: Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

page.description: 1-based page the item starts on; null when the format has no pages or Docling recorded none.

content.description: Text of the element (a table is GitHub-flavoured Markdown). Never blank.

level.description: Heading depth; null for every other type.

parent_id.description: element_id of the heading this element sits under, or null at the top level.

id.description: Since 1.1. The element's ID in the source (a structured source's node ID), unique among non-null ids; null on an element that has no source ID of its own. Absent when the source has no IDs.

title.description: Since 1.1. The source node's title, on a non-heading element whose content is not the title. A heading's title is its content.

properties.description: Since 1.1. Extra source fields the mapping names: lowercase identifier -> non-blank string.

level.description: A heading's level is an integer from 1 (top) to 100.

dropped.description: Source content that was not emitted as an element.

detected_format.description: Validated input format, e.g. pdf, html, docx, txt, json, csv, xlsx.

page_count.description: Pages in the source; null for unpaginated formats (HTML, DOCX, text, structured sources).

title.description: The document's title as Docling labelled it, or a structured source's mapping title; or null.

processing_time_ms.description: Wall time of the conversion worker in milliseconds.

structuredSource.description: Since 1.1. Present when the input was a structured source read through a mapping.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the mapping file the conversion used.

unmapped_fields.description: Source fields (JSON keys on nodes, or column headers) the mapping did not use, in first-seen order.
